Option.value:
CASE -- 1. Durum: Limit 0 ise GND WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" = '0' THEN 'GND'
-- 2. Durum: UNL Kontrolü (Hatalı mantık düzeltildi) WHEN ("ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" IN ('MSL', 'AGL') AND "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" = '99999') OR ("ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'STD' AND "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" = '999') THEN 'UNL'
-- 3. Durum: Referans STD ise FL ekle WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'STD' THEN 'FL ' || "ais_UPPER_LIMIT"
-- 4. Durum: Referans MSL ise FT AMSL ekle WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'MSL' THEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" || ' FT AMSL'
-- 5. Durum: Referans AGL ise FT AGL ekle WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'AGL' THEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" || ' FT AGL'
ELSE "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" END
Option.name: expression

-- 4. Durum: Referans MSL ise FT AMSL ekle WHEN "ais_LOWER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'MSL' THEN "ais_LOWER_LIMIT" || ' FT AMSL'
-- 5. Durum: Referans AGL ise FT AGL ekle WHEN "ais_LOWER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'AGL' THEN "ais_LOWER_LIMIT" || ' FT AGL'
